Kush.name: Piye
Kush.note: Conquered Egypt and founded its Twenty-fifth Dynasty.
Kush.note_zh: 征服埃及，建立埃及第二十五王朝。

Kush.name: Taharqa
Kush.note: Ruled Egypt and Kush until driven south by Assyria.
Kush.note_zh: 统治埃及和库施，后被亚述赶回南方。

Kush.name: Tantamani
Kush.note_zh: 统治埃及的最后一位库施国王。

Meroe.name: Arkamani I
Meroe.note_zh: 将王室墓地迁至麦罗埃。

Meroe.name: Amanirenas
Meroe.note: Fought Rome to a peace treaty in 21 or 20 BCE.
Meroe.note_zh: 与罗马作战，于公元前21或前20年议和。

Meroe.name: Natakamani
Meroe.note: Ruled with Queen Amanitore and built many temples.
Meroe.note_zh: 与女王阿玛尼托共治，修建了许多神庙。

check.n: Reign dating disputed: older chronology c. 1 BC-AD 20, current view mid-1st century CE (Nero era).
check.n_zh: 在位年代有争议：旧说约公元前1年至公元20年，现多认为公元1世纪中叶（尼禄时代）。

Axum.name: Zoskales
Axum.note: Named in the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea.
Axum.note_zh: 见于《厄立特里亚海航行记》。

Axum.name: Endubis
Axum.note: First Aksumite king to issue coins.
Axum.note_zh: 最早铸造钱币的阿克苏姆国王。

Axum.name: Ezana
Axum.note_zh: 皈依基督教，征服麦罗埃。

Axum.name: Kaleb
Axum.note_zh: 约525年出兵也门的希木叶尔王国。

Axum.name: Ashama ibn Abjar
Axum.note: Sheltered the first Muslim refugees from Mecca.
Axum.note_zh: 收留来自麦加的第一批穆斯林避难者。

people.name: Frumentius
people.known_for: Syrian Greek who converted King Ezana and became the first bishop of Aksum.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚希腊人，使阿克苏姆国王埃扎纳皈依基督教，成为阿克苏姆第一任主教。

people.name: Saint Yared
people.known_for: Composer who created the sacred chant and musical notation of the Ethiopian church.
people.known_for_zh: 埃塞俄比亚作曲家，创立埃塞俄比亚正教会的圣乐和记谱法。

Ghana.name: Tunka Manin
Ghana.note: Described by al-Bakri in 1068 as a rich king with a great army.
Ghana.note_zh: 据巴克里1068年记载，是拥有大军的富有国王。

Kanem.name: Hummay
Kanem.note: First Muslim ruler of Kanem, founder of the Sayfawa line.
Kanem.note_zh: 加涅姆第一位穆斯林君主，开创赛法瓦王朝。

Kanem.name: Dunama Dabbalemi
Kanem.note: Kanem reached its greatest extent under him.
Kanem.note_zh: 在其统治下加涅姆疆域最大。

Makkura.name: Merkurios
Makkura.note_zh: 统一诺巴迪亚和马库里亚。

Zagwe dynasty.name: Gebre Meskel Lalibela
Zagwe dynasty.note: Built the rock-hewn churches of Lalibela.
Zagwe dynasty.note_zh: 修建拉利贝拉岩石教堂群。

people.name: Gebre Meskel Lalibela
people.known_for: Zagwe king who had eleven churches cut from solid rock as a new Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 扎格维王朝国王，下令在整块岩石中凿出十一座教堂，意在建造“新耶路撒冷”。

Mali.name: Sundiata Keita
Mali.note: Founded the empire after the battle of Kirina.
Mali.note_zh: 基里纳之战后建立马里帝国。

Mali.name: Abubakari II
Mali.note: Said to have sailed into the Atlantic and never returned.
Mali.note_zh: 据说率船队驶入大西洋后一去不返。

Mali.name: Musa I
Mali.note: Made the famous pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324.

Mali.name: Suleyman
Mali.note: Ruled when Ibn Battuta visited in 1352.
Mali.note_zh: 伊本·白图泰1352年来访时在位。

Ethiopia.name: Zara Yaqob
Ethiopia.note_zh: 强势君主，推行宗教改革。

Kanem-Bornu.name: Umar ibn Idris
Kanem-Bornu.note: Moved the court from Kanem to Bornu.
Kanem-Bornu.note_zh: 将王廷从加涅姆迁往博尔努。

Benin.name: Ewuare
Benin.note: Rebuilt Benin City and expanded the kingdom.
Benin.note_zh: 重建贝宁城并扩张王国。

people.name: Sundiata Keita
people.known_for: Founder of the Mali Empire, hero of the Epic of Sundiata told by griots.
people.known_for_zh: 马里帝国的创建者，击败索索王苏曼古鲁，是格里奥口传史诗《松迪亚塔》的英雄。

people.name: Mansa Musa
people.known_for: Mali emperor whose lavish pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324 made Mali famous as a land of gold.
people.known_for_zh: 马里帝国国王，1324年携带大量黄金赴麦加朝觐，使马里以“黄金之国”闻名于世。

people.name: Abu Ishaq al-Sahili
people.known_for: Andalusian poet and architect said to have built the Djinguereber Mosque in Timbuktu for Mansa Musa.
people.known_for_zh: 安达卢斯诗人、建筑师，相传为曼萨·穆萨在廷巴克图修建了津加里贝尔清真寺。

people.name: Tekle Haymanot
people.known_for: Monk who founded the monastery of Debre Libanos, the most revered saint of Ethiopia.
people.known_for_zh: 埃塞俄比亚修士，创建德布雷利巴诺斯修道院，是埃塞俄比亚最受尊崇的圣徒。

people.name: Ewostatewos
people.known_for: Monk whose followers kept the Sabbath and formed a major monastic movement in northern Ethiopia.
people.known_for_zh: 埃塞俄比亚修士，主张遵守安息日，其门徒在北部形成重要的修道运动。

people.name: Giyorgis of Segla
people.known_for: Ethiopian monk and theologian, author of the Book of Mystery.
people.known_for_zh: 埃塞俄比亚修士、神学家，著有《奥秘之书》，是盖兹语文学的重要作者。

Songhai.name: Sunni Ali
Songhai.note: Took Timbuktu in 1468 and Djenné in 1473.
Songhai.note_zh: 1468年攻占廷巴克图，1473年攻占杰内。

Songhai.name: Askia Muhammad I
Songhai.name_zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德一世
Songhai.note: Founded the Askia dynasty and expanded the empire.
Songhai.note_zh: 建立阿斯基亚王朝，大力扩张帝国。

Songhai.name: Askia Muhammad Bani
Songhai.name_zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德·巴尼

Songhai.name: Askia Ishaq II
Songhai.note: Defeated by Morocco at Tondibi in 1591.
Songhai.note_zh: 1591年在通迪比战役中被摩洛哥军击败。

Congo.name: Nzinga a Nkuwu (João I)
Congo.name_zh: 恩津加·恩库伍（若昂一世）

Congo.name: Álvaro I
Congo.note: Restored with Portuguese help after the Jaga invasion.
Congo.note_zh: 雅加人入侵后借葡萄牙之助复位。

Ethiopia.name: Lebna Dengel (Dawit II)
Ethiopia.note: Lost most of the empire to Ahmad Gragn.
Ethiopia.note_zh: 大部分国土被艾哈迈德·格兰占领。

Ethiopia.name: Gelawdewos
Ethiopia.note: Defeated Ahmad Gragn in 1543 with Portuguese help.
Ethiopia.note_zh: 1543年在葡萄牙人帮助下击败艾哈迈德·格兰。

Benin.name: Ozolua
Benin.note_zh: 接待最早到来的葡萄牙人。

Benin.name: Esigie
Benin.note: Benin's bronze casting flourished under him.
Benin.note_zh: 其在位时贝宁青铜铸造艺术繁荣。

people.name: Muhammad al-Maghili
people.known_for: Islamic scholar from Tlemcen who advised the rulers of Kano and Songhai on Islamic government.
people.known_for_zh: 来自特莱姆森的伊斯兰学者，为卡诺和桑海的统治者撰写治国之道。

people.name: Ahmad Baba al-Timbukti
people.known_for: Timbuktu scholar and jurist who wrote dozens of works and was exiled to Morocco after 1591.
people.known_for_zh: 廷巴克图学者、法学家，著述数十部，1591年后被掳往摩洛哥，晚年返回故乡。

people.name: Afonso I of Kongo
people.known_for: King of Kongo who made the kingdom Christian and protested to Portugal against the slave trade.
people.known_for_zh: 刚果国王，推行基督教化，曾写信向葡萄牙国王抗议奴隶贸易。

people.name: Diogo Cão
people.known_for: Portuguese navigator who reached the mouth of the Congo River in 1482.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙航海家，1482年到达刚果河口，开启葡萄牙与刚果王国的交往。

people.name: Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi
people.known_for: Imam of Adal who conquered most of the Ethiopian highlands between 1529 and 1543.
people.known_for_zh: 阿达尔苏丹国伊玛目，1529至1543年间征服埃塞俄比亚高原大部分地区。

people.name: Cristóvão da Gama
people.known_for: Son of Vasco da Gama who led a Portuguese force to help Ethiopia and was killed by Ahmad Gragn.
people.known_for_zh: 达·伽马之子，率葡萄牙援军帮助埃塞俄比亚，被艾哈迈德·格兰俘杀。

people.name: Francisco Álvares
people.name_zh: 弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯
people.known_for: Portuguese priest whose account of six years in Ethiopia was Europe's main source on the country.
people.known_for_zh: 葡萄牙神父，记述在埃塞俄比亚六年的见闻，成为欧洲了解该国的主要资料。

works.title: A True Relation of the Lands of Prester John

people.name: Amina of Zazzau
people.known_for: Hausa warrior queen of Zazzau who led campaigns and built walled towns.
people.known_for_zh: 豪萨城邦扎扎乌的女王，亲自领兵征战，修筑城墙，被尼日利亚人视为女英雄。

Oyo.name: Gaha
Oyo.note: Chief minister who made and unmade kings.
Oyo.note_zh: 权倾一时的首席大臣，可任意废立国王。

Oyo.name: Abiodun
Oyo.note: Overthrew Gaha; Oyo was at its height.
Oyo.note_zh: 推翻加哈，奥约达到鼎盛。

Dahomey.name: Agaja
Dahomey.note: Conquered the coast at Allada and Whydah.
Dahomey.note_zh: 征服沿海的阿拉达和维达。

Ethiopia.name: Susenyos I
Ethiopia.note: Converted to Catholicism, causing a civil war.

Ethiopia.name: Fasilides
Ethiopia.note: Expelled the Jesuits and built Gondar.
Ethiopia.note_zh: 驱逐耶稣会士，营建贡德尔城。

Ethiopia.name: Iyoas I
Ethiopia.note: His murder began the Era of the Princes.
Ethiopia.note_zh: 其被杀标志“王子时代”开始。

people.name: Nzinga of Ndongo and Matamba
people.known_for: Queen of Ndongo and Matamba who resisted Portuguese conquest for four decades.
people.known_for_zh: 恩东戈和马坦巴女王，以外交和战争抵抗葡萄牙入侵长达四十年。

people.name: Abd al-Rahman al-Sadi
people.known_for: Timbuktu scholar who wrote the Tarikh al-Sudan, the main history of the Songhai Empire.
people.known_for_zh: 廷巴克图学者，著有《苏丹史》，是研究桑海帝国最重要的史料。

people.name: Zera Yacob
people.known_for: Ethiopian philosopher whose Hatata argued that reason, not authority, is the path to truth.
people.known_for_zh: 埃塞俄比亚哲学家，在《探究》中主张以理性而非权威探求真理。

people.name: Pedro Páez
people.known_for: Spanish Jesuit in Ethiopia who reached the source of the Blue Nile in 1618.
people.known_for_zh: 在埃塞俄比亚传教的西班牙耶稣会士，1618年到达青尼罗河源头。

people.name: Jan van Riebeeck
people.known_for: Dutch East India Company official who founded the Cape settlement in 1652.
people.known_for_zh: 荷兰东印度公司官员，1652年在好望角建立补给站，即开普敦的起源。

people.name: Okomfo Anokye
people.known_for: Priest who helped Osei Tutu found Asante and, by tradition, called down the Golden Stool.
people.known_for_zh: 祭司，协助奥塞·图图建立阿散蒂王国，相传从天上召下象征国家的“金凳”。

people.name: Kimpa Vita
people.known_for: Kongo prophet who led a movement to reunite the kingdom and was burned for heresy.
people.known_for_zh: 刚果女先知，领导宗教运动力图重新统一王国，1706年以异端罪被烧死。

people.name: James Bruce
people.known_for: Scottish traveller who reached the source of the Blue Nile in 1770 and described Ethiopia.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格兰旅行家，1770年到达青尼罗河源头，详细记述埃塞俄比亚。

works.title: Travels to Discover the Source of the Nile

people.name: Olaudah Equiano
people.known_for: Former slave whose autobiography of 1789 helped the campaign to abolish the slave trade.
people.known_for_zh: 曾为奴隶，1789年出版的自传有力推动了英国废除奴隶贸易运动。

works.title: The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano
works.title_zh: 奥拉达·艾奎亚诺的有趣叙述

people.name: Philip Quaque
people.known_for: First African ordained in the Church of England, who ran a school at Cape Coast Castle.
people.known_for_zh: 第一位被英国国教会按立的非洲人，在海岸角城堡传教并办学。

people.name: Mungo Park
people.known_for: Scottish explorer who reached the Niger River in 1796 and died exploring it.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格兰探险家，1796年到达尼日尔河，第二次考察时遇难。

works.title: Travels in the Interior Districts of Africa

Sokoto Caliphate.name: Usman dan Fodio
Sokoto Caliphate.note: Led the jihad of 1804 and founded the caliphate.

Zulu.name: Dingane
Zulu.note: Defeated by the Boers at Blood River in 1838.

Zulu.name: Cetshwayo
Zulu.note: Beat the British at Isandlwana in 1879 before losing the war.
Zulu.note_zh: 1879年伊散德尔瓦纳之战大败英军，但最终战败。

Ethiopia.name: Tewodros II
Ethiopia.note: Ended the Era of the Princes; died at Magdala.
Ethiopia.note_zh: 结束王子时代，在马格达拉兵败自尽。

people.name: Usman dan Fodio
people.known_for: Fulani preacher whose jihad overthrew the Hausa kings and founded the Sokoto Caliphate.
people.known_for_zh: 富拉尼族伊斯兰学者，发动圣战推翻豪萨诸王，建立索科托哈里发国。

people.name: Nana Asma'u
people.known_for: Daughter of Usman dan Fodio, poet and teacher who set up a network to educate women.
people.known_for_zh: 奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥之女，诗人和教育家，建立培养女性教师的教育网络。

people.name: El Hadj Umar Tall
people.known_for: Tijani leader whose jihad created the Toucouleur Empire on the upper Niger.
people.known_for_zh: 提加尼教团领袖，发动圣战，在尼日尔河上游建立图库勒尔帝国。

people.name: Shaka
people.known_for: Zulu king who reorganised warfare and built the Zulu kingdom into a great power.
people.known_for_zh: 祖鲁国王，改革军事制度和战术，使祖鲁王国成为南部非洲强国。

people.name: Mzilikazi
people.known_for: Former Zulu commander who led his people north and founded the Ndebele kingdom.
people.known_for_zh: 原祖鲁将领，率部北迁，建立恩德贝莱王国。

people.name: Moshoeshoe I
people.known_for: Founder of the Basotho nation, who used diplomacy to keep his mountain kingdom free of the Boers.
people.known_for_zh: 巴苏陀民族的缔造者，以外交手段使山地王国免于被布尔人吞并，即今莱索托。

people.name: Said bin Sultan
people.known_for: Sultan of Oman who moved his capital to Zanzibar and made it the centre of the clove and slave trade.
people.known_for_zh: 阿曼苏丹，将都城迁到桑给巴尔，使其成为丁香和奴隶贸易中心。

people.name: Samuel Ajayi Crowther
people.known_for: Freed slave who became the first African Anglican bishop and translated the Bible into Yoruba.
people.known_for_zh: 获释奴隶出身，成为第一位非洲籍圣公会主教，将《圣经》译成约鲁巴语。

people.name: Joseph Jenkins Roberts
people.known_for: First president of Liberia when it declared independence in 1847.
people.known_for_zh: 利比里亚1847年宣布独立后的首任总统。

people.name: Edward Wilmot Blyden
people.name_zh: 爱德华·威尔莫特·布莱登
people.known_for: Liberian writer and educator, an early voice of Pan-Africanism.
people.known_for_zh: 利比里亚作家、教育家，泛非主义的早期倡导者。

works.title: Christianity, Islam and the Negro Race
works.title_zh: 基督教、伊斯兰教与黑人种族

people.name: Africanus Horton
people.known_for: Sierra Leonean army doctor and writer who argued for West African self-government.
people.known_for_zh: 塞拉利昂军医和作家，倡导西非自治，是非洲民族主义的先驱。

people.name: Jaja of Opobo
people.known_for: Former slave who founded the trading state of Opobo and controlled the palm oil trade.
people.known_for_zh: 奴隶出身的商人，建立奥波博城邦，控制尼日尔河三角洲的棕榈油贸易。

people.name: René Caillié
people.known_for: French explorer who in 1828 became the first European to return alive from Timbuktu.
people.known_for_zh: 法国探险家，1828年成为第一个到达廷巴克图并生还的欧洲人。

works.title: Travels through Central Africa to Timbuctoo

people.name: Heinrich Barth
people.known_for: German scholar whose journeys of 1850 to 1855 gave Europe a careful record of West African history.
people.known_for_zh: 德国学者、探险家，1850至1855年考察西非和中非，留下详实的历史记录。

works.title: Travels and Discoveries in North and Central Africa

people.name: David Livingstone
people.known_for: Scottish missionary who crossed Africa, reached Victoria Falls and campaigned against the slave trade.
people.known_for_zh: 苏格兰传教士和探险家，横穿非洲大陆，到达维多利亚瀑布，并呼吁废除奴隶贸易。

people.name: John Hanning Speke
people.known_for: British explorer who identified Lake Victoria as the source of the White Nile.
people.known_for_zh: 英国探险家，确认维多利亚湖为白尼罗河的源头。

works.title: Journal of the Discovery of the Source of the Nile

people.name: Henry Morton Stanley
people.known_for: Explorer who found Livingstone in 1871 and traced the Congo River to the sea.
people.known_for_zh: 探险家，1871年找到利文斯通，后沿刚果河而下直达大西洋。

Belgian Congo.name_zh: 刚果自由邦与比属刚果

Abyssinia.name: Yohannes IV
Abyssinia.note: Killed fighting the Mahdists at Gallabat.
Abyssinia.note_zh: 在加拉巴特与马赫迪军作战时阵亡。

Abyssinia.name: Haile Selassie
Abyssinia.note: In exile during the Italian occupation of 1936 to 1941.

Union of South Africa.name: D. F. Malan
Union of South Africa.note_zh: 其政府开始推行种族隔离制度。

Belgian Congo.name: Leopold II
Belgian Congo.note: Ran the Congo as his private colony with great brutality; Belgium annexed it in 1908.
Belgian Congo.note_zh: 将刚果作为私人领地残酷统治，1908年由比利时政府接管。
Belgian Congo.rank: Sovereign of the Congo Free State

people.name: Taytu Betul
people.known_for: Empress and wife of Menelik II who founded Addis Ababa and led troops at Adwa.
people.known_for_zh: 孟尼利克二世的皇后，选定并创建亚的斯亚贝巴，在阿杜瓦战役中亲自率军。

people.name: Samori Ture
people.known_for: Founder of the Wassoulou Empire who fought French conquest from 1882 to 1898.
people.known_for_zh: 瓦苏卢帝国创建者，1882至1898年坚持抵抗法国侵略。

people.name: Rabih az-Zubayr
people.known_for: Sudanese warlord who conquered Bornu and was killed fighting the French at Kousséri.
people.known_for_zh: 苏丹军阀，征服博尔努，1900年在库塞里与法军作战时阵亡。

people.name: Yaa Asantewaa
people.known_for: Queen mother who led the Asante War of the Golden Stool against the British in 1900.
people.known_for_zh: 阿散蒂王太后，1900年领导反抗英国的“金凳之战”。

people.name: Paul Kruger
people.known_for: President of the Transvaal who led the Boers against Britain in the Second Boer War.
people.known_for_zh: 德兰士瓦共和国总统，在第二次布尔战争中领导布尔人抵抗英国。

people.name: Cecil Rhodes
people.known_for: Mining magnate and Cape premier whose company seized the lands later called Rhodesia.
people.known_for_zh: 矿业巨头、开普殖民地总理，其公司侵占了后来以他命名的罗得西亚。

people.name: Hendrik Witbooi
people.known_for: Nama leader who resisted German rule in South West Africa and fell in the war of 1904 to 1905.
people.known_for_zh: 纳马人首领，抵抗德国在西南非洲的殖民统治，1905年战死。

people.name: Mbuya Nehanda
people.known_for: Shona spirit medium who inspired the rising of 1896 against British rule and was hanged.
people.known_for_zh: 绍纳人灵媒，激励1896年反抗英国统治的起义，后被处以绞刑。

people.name: John Chilembwe
people.known_for: Baptist pastor who led a rising against British rule in Nyasaland in 1915.
people.known_for_zh: 浸信会牧师，1915年在尼亚萨兰领导反抗英国殖民统治的起义。

people.name: Simon Kimbangu
people.known_for: Congolese prophet jailed for life by the Belgians, whose followers founded a large African church.
people.known_for_zh: 刚果先知，被比利时当局判处终身监禁，其追随者创立了庞大的基班古教会。

people.name: Albert Schweitzer
people.known_for: Alsatian doctor and thinker who ran a hospital at Lambaréné and won the Nobel Peace Prize.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔萨斯医生和思想家，在加蓬兰巴雷内行医数十年，获诺贝尔和平奖。

works.title: The Quest of the Historical Jesus

people.name: John Dube
people.known_for: First president of the South African Native National Congress, later the ANC.
people.known_for_zh: 南非土著人国民大会（后来的非洲人国民大会）首任主席。

people.name: Sol Plaatje
people.known_for: Founder member of the ANC and author of the first novel in English by a black South African.
people.known_for_zh: 非洲人国民大会创始人之一，写出南非黑人第一部英语长篇小说《穆迪》。

people.name: Blaise Diagne
people.known_for: First black African elected to the French National Assembly, in 1914.
people.known_for_zh: 1914年当选法国国民议会议员，是第一位进入法国议会的非洲黑人。

people.name: Herbert Macaulay
people.known_for: Engineer and journalist regarded as the founder of Nigerian nationalism.
people.known_for_zh: 工程师、记者，创建尼日利亚第一个政党，被视为尼日利亚民族主义之父。

people.name: Harry Thuku
people.known_for: Early Kenyan nationalist whose arrest in 1922 led to a deadly protest in Nairobi.
people.known_for_zh: 肯尼亚早期民族主义者，1922年被捕引发内罗毕的大规模抗议。

people.name: Amos Tutuola
people.known_for: Nigerian writer whose The Palm-Wine Drinkard drew on Yoruba folk tales.
people.known_for_zh: 尼日利亚作家，代表作《棕榈酒鬼》取材于约鲁巴民间故事。

people.name: Alan Paton
people.known_for: South African novelist whose Cry, the Beloved Country exposed racial injustice.
people.known_for_zh: 南非作家，代表作《哭泣吧，亲爱的祖国》揭露南非的种族不公。

Nigeria.name: Abubakar Tafawa Balewa
Nigeria.name_zh: 阿布巴卡尔·塔法瓦·巴勒瓦
Nigeria.note: Killed in the coup of January 1966.

Nigeria.name: Yakubu Gowon
Nigeria.note: Led the federal side in the civil war of 1967 to 1970.
Nigeria.note_zh: 在1967至1970年内战中领导联邦政府。

South Africa.name: Hendrik Verwoerd
South Africa.note: Chief architect of apartheid; South Africa became a republic in 1961.
South Africa.note_zh: 种族隔离制度的主要设计者；1961年南非成为共和国。

South Africa.name: F. W. de Klerk
South Africa.name_zh: 弗雷德里克·威廉·德克勒克
South Africa.note_zh: 释放曼德拉，结束种族隔离制度。

people.name: Kwame Nkrumah
people.known_for: Led the Gold Coast to independence as Ghana in 1957 and championed Pan-African unity.
people.known_for_zh: 领导黄金海岸于1957年独立为加纳，是泛非主义和非洲统一的倡导者。

people.name: Patrice Lumumba
people.known_for: First prime minister of the independent Congo, overthrown and murdered in 1961.
people.known_for_zh: 刚果独立后首任总理，1960年被推翻，次年遇害，成为非洲独立运动的象征。

people.name: Julius Nyerere
people.known_for: First president of Tanzania, known as Mwalimu, the teacher, for his ideas of African socialism.
people.known_for_zh: 坦桑尼亚首任总统，被尊称为“导师”，倡导乌贾马非洲社会主义。

people.name: Jomo Kenyatta
people.known_for: Nationalist jailed by the British who became Kenya's first president.
people.known_for_zh: 肯尼亚民族主义领袖，曾被英国当局囚禁，后任肯尼亚首任总统。

people.name: Haile Selassie
people.known_for: Emperor of Ethiopia who appealed to the League of Nations in 1936 and hosted the founding of the OAU in 1963.
people.known_for_zh: 埃塞俄比亚皇帝，1936年在国际联盟发表演说，1963年在亚的斯亚贝巴主持成立非洲统一组织。

people.name: Léopold Sédar Senghor
people.name_zh: 利奥波德·塞达尔·桑戈尔
people.known_for: Poet of Négritude and first president of Senegal.
people.known_for_zh: “黑人性”运动的代表诗人，塞内加尔首任总统。

people.name: Cheikh Anta Diop
people.known_for: Senegalese historian who argued for the African roots of ancient Egyptian civilisation.
people.known_for_zh: 塞内加尔历史学家，主张古埃及文明源自非洲黑人。

people.name: Ousmane Sembène
people.known_for: Senegalese writer and film director, called the father of African cinema.
people.known_for_zh: 塞内加尔作家、电影导演，被称为“非洲电影之父”。

people.name: Mariama Bâ
people.known_for: Senegalese novelist whose So Long a Letter told of women's lives under polygamy.
people.known_for_zh: 塞内加尔女作家，书信体小说《一封如此长的信》讲述一夫多妻制下女性的命运。

people.name: Chinua Achebe
people.known_for: Nigerian novelist whose Things Fall Apart is the most widely read African novel.
people.known_for_zh: 尼日利亚作家，代表作《瓦解》是读者最多的非洲小说，被誉为“非洲现代文学之父”。

people.name: Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o
people.known_for: Kenyan writer who turned from English to writing in Gikuyu and was jailed for his work.
people.known_for_zh: 肯尼亚作家，后改用基库尤语写作，曾因作品入狱。

people.name: Amílcar Cabral
people.known_for: Agronomist and theorist who led the liberation war of Guinea-Bissau and Cape Verde.
people.known_for_zh: 农学家和革命理论家，领导几内亚比绍和佛得角的民族解放战争，1973年遇刺。

people.name: Ahmed Sékou Touré
people.known_for: Guinean leader who rejected de Gaulle's offer in 1958 and made Guinea independent.
people.known_for_zh: 几内亚领导人，1958年拒绝戴高乐的方案，使几内亚率先脱离法国独立。

people.name: Kenneth Kaunda
people.known_for: First president of Zambia, who backed the liberation movements of southern Africa.
people.known_for_zh: 赞比亚首任总统，支持南部非洲的民族解放运动，与中国合作修建坦赞铁路。

people.name: Samora Machel
people.known_for: Leader of FRELIMO and first president of Mozambique.
people.known_for_zh: 莫桑比克解放阵线领导人，莫桑比克首任总统，1986年死于空难。

people.name: Agostinho Neto
people.known_for: Poet and leader of the MPLA who became the first president of Angola.
people.known_for_zh: 诗人，安哥拉人民解放运动领导人，安哥拉首任总统。

people.name: Thomas Sankara
people.known_for: Revolutionary leader who renamed his country Burkina Faso and was killed in a coup.
people.known_for_zh: 革命领导人，将国名改为布基纳法索，推行激进改革，1987年在政变中被杀。

people.name: Idi Amin
people.known_for: Military dictator of Uganda from 1971 to 1979, whose rule killed many thousands.
people.known_for_zh: 乌干达军事独裁者，1971至1979年统治期间大批民众遇害。

people.name: Robert Mugabe
people.known_for: Guerrilla leader who became Zimbabwe's first prime minister in 1980 and ruled until 2017.
people.known_for_zh: 游击队领导人，1980年津巴布韦独立后任总理，后任总统，执政至2017年。

people.name: Nelson Mandela
people.known_for: Anti-apartheid leader jailed for 27 years who became South Africa's first black president in 1994.
people.known_for_zh: 反种族隔离领袖，被囚禁27年，1994年成为南非首位黑人总统。

people.name: Steve Biko
people.known_for: Founder of the Black Consciousness Movement who died in police custody.
people.known_for_zh: 南非“黑人觉醒运动”创始人，1977年死于警察拘押之中。

people.name: Desmond Tutu
people.known_for: Anglican archbishop who fought apartheid peacefully and won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1984.
people.known_for_zh: 南非圣公会大主教，以非暴力方式反对种族隔离，1984年获诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Miriam Makeba
people.known_for: South African singer, known as Mama Africa, who spoke against apartheid from exile.
people.known_for_zh: 南非歌手，被称为“非洲妈妈”，流亡海外时坚持反对种族隔离。

people.name: Hugh Masekela
people.known_for: Jazz trumpeter whose song Bring Him Back Home became an anthem for Mandela's release.
people.known_for_zh: 南非爵士小号手，歌曲《带他回家》成为呼吁释放曼德拉的颂歌。

people.name: Fela Kuti
people.known_for: Nigerian musician who created Afrobeat and attacked military rule in his songs.
people.known_for_zh: 尼日利亚音乐家，开创“非洲节拍”音乐，用歌曲抨击军政府。

Nigeria.name: Abdulsalami Abubakar
Nigeria.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒萨拉米·阿布巴卡尔
Nigeria.note: Handed power to an elected government.

Ethiopia.name: Hailemariam Desalegn
Ethiopia.name_zh: 海尔马里亚姆·德萨莱尼

people.name: Wangari Maathai
people.known_for: Biologist who founded the Green Belt Movement and won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2004.
people.known_for_zh: 肯尼亚生物学家，创立“绿带运动”植树数千万棵，2004年获诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Ken Saro-Wiwa
people.known_for: Writer and Ogoni activist hanged by the Abacha regime for protesting oil pollution.
people.known_for_zh: 尼日利亚作家、奥戈尼族活动家，因抗议石油污染被阿巴查政权处以绞刑。

people.name: John Garang
people.known_for: Leader of the southern Sudanese rebellion who signed the peace of 2005 and died weeks later.
people.known_for_zh: 苏丹人民解放运动领导人，2005年签署全面和平协议，数周后死于直升机失事。

people.name: Laurent-Désiré Kabila
people.known_for: Rebel leader who overthrew Mobutu in 1997 and was assassinated in 2001.
people.known_for_zh: 叛军领导人，1997年推翻蒙博托，2001年遇刺身亡。

people.name: Jonas Savimbi
people.known_for: UNITA leader whose war against the Angolan government ended only with his death in 2002.
people.known_for_zh: 安盟领导人，与安哥拉政府长期内战，2002年阵亡后内战才结束。

people.name: John Magufuli
people.known_for: President of Tanzania known for his anti-corruption drive.
people.known_for_zh: 坦桑尼亚总统，以强力反腐和推动基础设施建设著称。

people.name: Morgan Tsvangirai
people.known_for: Trade union leader who led the opposition to Mugabe and served as prime minister from 2009 to 2013.
people.known_for_zh: 工会领袖，领导反对穆加贝的运动，2009至2013年任津巴布韦总理。

people.name: Sam Nujoma
people.known_for: Leader of SWAPO and first president of independent Namibia.
people.known_for_zh: 西南非洲人民组织领导人，纳米比亚独立后的首任总统。

people.name: Ali Farka Touré
people.known_for: Malian guitarist who brought the desert blues of the Niger to world audiences.
people.known_for_zh: 马里吉他手，把尼日尔河畔的“沙漠蓝调”带向世界，曾获格莱美奖。

people.name: Papa Wemba
people.known_for: Congolese singer, the king of rumba rock, who made Kinshasa music famous worldwide.
people.known_for_zh: 刚果歌手，被称为“伦巴摇滚之王”，使金沙萨音乐风靡世界。

people.name: Oliver Mtukudzi
people.known_for: Zimbabwean singer and guitarist, one of Africa's best known musicians.
people.known_for_zh: 津巴布韦歌手、吉他手，非洲最知名的音乐家之一。

people.name: Ahmadou Kourouma
people.known_for: Ivorian novelist whose Allah Is Not Obliged tells of a child soldier.
people.known_for_zh: 科特迪瓦作家，小说《安拉不必如此》讲述一名童兵的遭遇。

people.name: Kofi Awoonor
people.known_for: Ghanaian poet and diplomat, killed in the Westgate mall attack in Nairobi.
people.known_for_zh: 加纳诗人、外交家，诗作融合埃维族挽歌传统，2013年在内罗毕购物中心袭击中遇难。

people.name: Binyavanga Wainaina
people.known_for: Kenyan writer known for the satirical essay How to Write About Africa.
people.known_for_zh: 肯尼亚作家，以讽刺散文《如何书写非洲》闻名。
